global_rules: Never use pure black #000000. Use deep OLED blacks like #0A0A0C.
Avoid heavy borders. Use 1px borders with low opacity (e.g., border-white/5) to define edges.
Rely on typography and spacing for hierarchy, not card shadows.
Hover states must always be clearly defined for all interactive elements.
Implement micro-interactions for tactile feedback (e.g., active:scale-95).

fonts.body: Plus Jakarta Sans, Noto Sans Devanagari, sans-serif

header.layout: Sticky top-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-between p-4

elements.balance_badge: flex items-center gap-2 bg-[#D4AF37]/10 border border-[#D4AF37]/20 text-[#FDE047] px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-sm font-medium

quick_action_grid.card: flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 bg-[#141418] border border-white/5 rounded-xl p-3 hover:bg-[#1C1C22] transition-colors active:scale-95
quick_action_grid.icon_wrapper: w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-white/5 flex items-center justify-center text-[#D4AF37]
quick_action_grid.label: text-xs font-medium text-gray-300

section_header.layout: flex items-center justify-between px-4 mt-6 mb-3
section_header.title: text-lg font-bold text-white tracking-tight
section_header.badge: bg-white/10 text-gray-300 text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-sm font-medium

game_card.layout: flex items-center justify-between bg-[#141418] border border-white/5 rounded-xl p-4 mb-3 mx-4 hover:border-white/10 transition-colors

result_boxes.yesterday: bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/20 text-red-400 rounded-md p-1.5 min-w-[44px] flex flex-col items-center justify-center relative
result_boxes.today: bg-green-500/10 border border-green-500/20 text-green-400 rounded-md p-1.5 min-w-[44px] flex flex-col items-center justify-center relative
result_boxes.live_badge: absolute -top-2 bg-green-500 text-black text-[8px] font-bold px-1 rounded-sm animate-pulse

status_icon.circle_running: w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-green-500/20 text-green-500 flex items-center justify-center shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(16,185,129,0.15)]
status_icon.circle_closed: w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-red-500/20 text-red-500 flex items-center justify-center
status_icon.label: text-[9px] text-gray-400 font-medium

bottom_nav.layout: fixed bottom-0 w-full bg-[#0A0A0C]/95 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-white/5 flex items-center justify-around p-2 pb-safe
bottom_nav.item: flex flex-col items-center gap-1 p-2 w-16
bottom_nav.label: text-[10px] font-medium

sidebar.menu_item: flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 text-gray-300 hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-white transition-colors

notification_popup.layout: fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm p-4
notification_popup.card: w-full max-w-sm bg-[#141418] border border-[#D4AF37]/30 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden relative shadow-[0_0_40px_rgba(212,175,55,0.1)]
notification_popup.image_overlay: absolute inset-0 opacity-20 bg-cover bg-center mix-blend-overlay
notification_popup.content: relative p-6 flex flex-col items-center text-center gap-4
notification_popup.icon_wrapper: w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-[#D4AF37]/10 flex items-center justify-center border border-[#D4AF37]/20
notification_popup.title: text-xl font-bold text-white
notification_popup.button_primary: w-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#D4AF37] to-[#FDE047] text-black font-bold py-3 rounded-xl hover:opacity-90 active:scale-95 transition-all
notification_popup.button_secondary: w-full bg-white/5 text-gray-300 font-medium py-3 rounded-xl hover:bg-white/10 active:scale-95 transition-all

image_urls.description: Gold particles floating against a dark background, used for the notification permission popup to add a premium luxury feel.

rules: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid.
Use kebab-case, role-based identifiers (e.g., data-testid='wallet-quick-action', data-testid='game-card-gali', data-testid='notification-allow-btn').
